slug: 我有装备栏460上次那一位

当晚，齐知玄在二牛家里凑合了一夜。
第二天黎明，天还未亮。
齐知玄和二牛早早起床，一起离开白石村。
头也不回地走了。
像是下定了某种决心。
“跟上了，阳谷县在二十里外呢。”
二牛大步流星，走得很快。
进城这条路，一来一回，他几乎每天都要走两遍，驾轻就熟。
齐知玄迈着细痩的双腿，不断地调整呼吸，努力跟上二牛的脚步。
晨光拂过之际，满头大汗的齐知玄抬起头，终于看到了城楼的影子。
阳谷县城，没有想象中那种恢弘气派。
只见，矮砖矮墙之上，斑斑驳驳，石墙上的裂缝纵横交错，犹如老人皮肤松弛的纹理。
城墙下，暗色锈痕爬满了残碑断碣，透出一份垂暮腐朽之气。
浮染着青苔的门楼上，镌刻着三个古老质朴的字符，遒劲飞舞。
没有意外的话，那三个字符应该读作：
阳谷城！
只可惜，不是汉字。
那是一种从未见过的异界文字，银钩虿尾，充满了力量和生命力。
“欸，我在这个世界就一个文盲，目不识丁。”齐知玄心中叹气。

常言道：
知识改变命运，勤奋创造奇迹。
你可以做一个没有文化的人，但绝不能真的没有文化。
齐知玄暗暗下定决心，自己必须尽快识文断字。
这会儿，时候尚早，城门还未打开。
但城门前，已有一条长龙队在蔓延。
有挑着新鲜蔬菜的农夫，有背着干柴的樵夫，也有提着一笼子鱼虾的渔民……
大家正在等待进城。
“二牛叔，进城需要交钱吗？”齐知玄压低声音问了句。
二牛摇头道：“进城不要交钱，但你要在城内摆摊做生意，胥吏就会问你要钱。”
齐知玄又问：“谁都能进城吗？”
二牛连道：“只要你不是通缉犯，都可以自由的进城出城。”
齐知玄心头迅速明了。
稍等片刻，伴随着一阵倒酸牙的声响，城门终于缓慢开启。
紧接着，几个穿皂衣的差役出现在城门口，呦呵着，指挥交通。
众人开始依次进城，井然有序。
齐知玄顺利进城，踏上了一条长长的青石街道。
放眼看去，城内建筑成群，楼台各异。
但不是那种粉墙黛瓦，雕梁画栋。
多数建筑是暗灰色的，透着一股陈旧老气。

That night, Qi Zhixuan spent the night at Er Niu's house.
At dawn the next day, it was still dark.
Qi Zhixuan and Er Niu got up early and left Baishi Village together.
He left without looking back.
As if he had made some kind of determination.
"Follow me, Yanggu County is twenty miles away."
Er Niu strode like lightning and walked very fast.
He walked this road into the city almost twice a day, back and forth, and he was very familiar with it.
Qi Zhixuan strode his thin legs, constantly adjusted his breathing, and tried hard to keep up with Er Niu.
As the morning light passed by, Qi Zhixuan, who was sweating profusely, raised his head and finally saw the shadow of the tower.
Yanggu County is not as grand as imagined.
I saw that the low brick wall was mottled, and the cracks on the stone wall were criss-crossed, like the texture of an old man's sagging skin.
Under the city wall, dark rust marks covered the broken steles and broken stone slabs, giving off an air of decay.
On the moss-stained gatehouse, three ancient and simple characters are engraved, dancing vigorously.
If there are no accidents, those three characters should read:
Yanggu City!
Unfortunately, it's not Chinese characters.
It was a type of alien writing that had never been seen before, a silver hook and a tail, full of power and vitality.
"Well, I am an illiterate person in this world." Qi Zhixuan sighed in his heart.
As the saying goes:
Knowledge changes destiny, and diligence creates miracles.
You can be an uneducated person, but you can never really be uneducated.
Qi Zhixuan secretly made up his mind that he must learn to read and write as soon as possible.
At this moment, it is still early and the city gate has not yet been opened.
But in front of the city gate, a long queue was already spreading.
There are farmers carrying fresh vegetables, woodcutter carrying dry firewood, and fishermen carrying cages of fish and shrimp...
Everyone is waiting to enter the city.
"Uncle Erniu, do I need to pay to enter the city?" Qi Zhixuan asked in a low voice.
Erniu shook his head and said, "You don't have to pay to enter the city, but if you set up a stall and do business in the city, the subordinate officials will ask you for money."
Qi Zhixuan asked again: "Can anyone enter the city?"
Erniu continued: "As long as you are not a wanted criminal, you can freely enter and leave the city."
Qi Zhixuan quickly understood.
After waiting for a moment, accompanied by the sound of grinding teeth, the city gate finally opened slowly.
Immediately afterwards, several officers in soap clothes appeared at the gate of the city, shouting and directing traffic.
Everyone began to enter the city in order.
Qi Zhixuan entered the city smoothly and stepped onto a long bluestone street.
Looking around, there are clusters of buildings in the city with different types of buildings.
But it's not the kind of whitewashed walls and black tiles with carved beams and painted pillars.
Most of the buildings are dark gray and look old-fashioned.
